title: Home Mortgage Loans Late Charge Schedule: Grace Days, Charge Rate by State and Courtesy Waiver Allowance
content:
This schedule forms part of the agreement the borrower signs on a Home Mortgage Loans note. It states the grace period allowed after an installment's due date, the late charge rate applied for the borrower's state of residence, and the number of courtesy waivers of a late charge allowed to one customer in a rolling 365 days.

## Grace period

The grace period is 15 calendar days after the due date on every one of the six programs: the FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, the VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, the Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, the Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage, the 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage and the Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage.

## Late charge rate by state of residence

The rate is a percent of the principal and interest part of the installment, read against the state in which the borrower resides.

| Program | North Carolina | South Carolina | Virginia |
|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 4.00 percent | 4.00 percent | 4.00 percent |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 4.00 percent | 4.00 percent | 4.00 percent |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 4.00 percent | 5.00 percent | 5.00 percent |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 4.00 percent | 5.00 percent | 5.00 percent |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 4.00 percent | 5.00 percent | 5.00 percent |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 4.00 percent | 5.00 percent | 5.00 percent |

A North Carolina borrower is charged 4.00 percent on every program. A South Carolina or Virginia borrower is charged 4.00 percent on the two agency programs and 5.00 percent on the other four.

## Courtesy waiver allowance

| Program | Courtesy waivers of a late charge allowed to one customer in a rolling 365 days |
|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 1 |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 1 |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 1 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 1 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 1 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 2 |

The allowance is 1 on five of the programs and 2 on the Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage, and it is counted per customer over a rolling 365 days.
